paite: Huan Elah tapa Israel kumpipa Hoshea, kum thum alal kum in hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Ahaz tapa Hezekiah alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Hezekiah / (2 Kro 29.1,2; 31.1)

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua alal a; anu min Abi, Zakariah tanu ahi.
Apu David thilhih tengteng hih sam in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Mun sangte ahihgawp a, suangphuhte ahihchim a, Asherahte aphuk a; Mosi dal gul bawl akitam nensak vek a; huai hun tanpha a Israel suante'n akiang a gimlim ahal ziak un, ama'n huai Nehushtan asa hi.
Ama'n TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian amuang a; huchi in anung a Judah kumpipa tengteng lak ah amah bang kuamah a-om kei ua, amalam in leng a-om sam kei uh.
TOUPA alen tinten a, ama zuih atawp nuam kei a, athupiak, TOUPA'N Mosi apiakte azui hi.
Huchi in TOUPA akiang ah a-om a; avakkhiakna peuh ah alamzang a; Assuria kumpipa tung ah ahel a, a-nna asemta kei hi.
Philistiate Gaza khua tan in agamgi chiang tengteng toh, galvilmi insang a pan kulh nei khopi tan in azou vek hi.
Kumpipa Hezekiah kum li alal kum, Israel kumpipa Elah tapa Hoshea kum sagih alal kum in hichi ahong hi a, Assuria kumpipa Salmaneser in Samaria ahong dou a, a-umkimvel a,
huchi in kum thum achin kum in alazou hi. Hezekiah kum guk alal kum, Israel kumpipa Hoshea kum kua alal kum in ahi Samaria khua alak zoh.
Assuria kumpipa'n Assuria gam ah Israel apimang a, Halah, Habor, Gozan lui leh Mediate khuate ah akoihta hi;
TOUPA a Pathian uh thu mang lou a, athukhun bohsia a, TOUPA'N asikha Mosi thu apiak tengteng azuih louh ziak un.
Kumpipa Hezekiah kum sawm-le-li alal kum in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib Judah gam a khokulh nei tengteng dou ding in ahohtou a, alata hi.
heading: Assuriate'n Jerusalem Vaulau Uh / (2 Kro 32.1-19; Isa 36.1-22)

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in Lakish a Assuria kumpipa kiang ah, "Thil ka na hihkhial hi, kei a pan kik nawn in, ka tung a na hon got peuhmah ka po ding," chi a gen ding in mi asawl hi. Assuria kumpipa'n Judah kumpipa Hezekiah dangka talent zathum leh dangka-eng talent sawmthum abikhiahsak hi.
Huchi in Hezekiah in TOUPA' inn a dangka om teng leh kongkhak a dangka-eng tengteng leh kumpipa gou koihkhawmna a om tengteng apia hi.
Huai tung mah in Hezekiah in TOUPA tempul kongkhak a dangka-eng aluante leh Judah kumpipa Hezekiah inn khuampite a kiluante alakhe vek a, Assuria kumpipa apia hi.

Assuria kumpipa'n Tartan, Rab-saris leh Rabshakeh sepaih tampi toh Lakish a pan Jerusalem a kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah asawl hi. Jerusalem khua atungtou ua; atuntouh un Puansawpmi Lamlian lampi a dil saknungzaw tuilakna kiang ah adingh uhi.
Kumpipa asap uleh, insung heutu Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joah, akiang uah ahong pawtkhia uhi.
Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Hezekiah kiang ah va gen dih ua, Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa in hichi in achi: Na gin a na muan bang ahia oi?
Kidouna a ding in geldan siam leh hatna ka nei uh, na chi a; himahleh huai zaw paukam lel ahi. Kua ahia na muan a ka tung a na hel maizen?
Tu in, ngai in, hiai sialluang chiangkhun, Aigupta muang na hita a; huai a mi akingaihleh akhut asun ding hi. Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh bel amah muang tengteng tung ah huchibang ahi naknak hi.

Ahihkeileh, ka kiang ah, TOUPA ka Pathian uh ahi ka muan uh, na chih uleh, amah pen Hezekiah in Judah leh Jerusalem kiang a Jerusalem a hiai maitam ma ah na biak ding uh ahi, chi a mun sangte leh amaitamte alakmangsakpa ahi kei a hia? chi in.
Huchi in ka pu Assuria kumpipa toh thu kichiam dih ua, huchi in atung a tuangmi ding na muh theih peuhmah ding leh sakol sangnih ka hon pe ding.
Bangchi in ahia kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite thu in Aigupta tung a na muanna koih in, ka pu mite lak a neupen heutu khat lel leng na nankik zoh mahmah ding?
Hiai gam TOUPA lou a hihse ding a hong kuantou ka hi a hia? TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, hiai gam dou inla, hihsia in, chi ahi,” chi in achi hi.

Hilkiah tapa Eliakim leh Sebnah leh Joahte'n Rabshakeh kiang ah, "Hehpih in na sikhate Siria pau in hon houpih in; huai lah ka theisiam ngal ua; kulh tung a mite zak in Judah pau in hon houpih nawn ke'n," achi uh.

Himahleh Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Ka pu in na pu uh kiang leh nou kiang kia ah hiai thu gen ding in ahon sawl a hia? Kulh tung a tute, noute leh a-ek uh ne dingte kiang ah leng hon sawl ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Rabshakeh adingh a, Judah pau in aw ngaihtak in akikou a, "Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa thu ngaikhia un.
Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, 'Hezekiah khem in om kei un; ama'n akhut a pan noute hon humbit thei lou ding ahi.
Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N ahon humbit dia; hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa khut ah piak ahi kei ding, chi in TOUPA ah hon muangsak kei hen.'

Hezekiah thu pom kei un. Assuria kumpipa'n hichi in achi: Hon kileppih unla, ka kiang ah hong pawtkhia un; michih in ama grepgui leh ama theipi kung ngei ate ne chiat uhenla, michih in amah tuikhuk tui dawn chiat hen.

Noumau gam bang a buh leh uain gam, tanghou leh grephuan gam, olive leh khuaizu gam, si lou a na hintheihna ding uh gam a ka hon pi masiah, Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N hon humbit ding, chi a nou ahon khem in leng pom kei un.
Namte' pathian mawngmawng lak a himhim in agam uh Assuria kumpipa a pan ahumbit ngeita uh hia?
Hamath leh Arpad pathiante koi a omta uh ahia? Sepharvaim, Hena leh Ivah pathiante leng koi a omta ahi ua? Samaria ka khut a pan ahumbit uhia?
Gam chih pathian tengteng lak a kuate ahi ua ka khut a pan agam uh humbit a, TOUPA'N Jerusalem khua kei a pan humbit mahmah ding? chi in,” achi hi.
Amau adai sipsip ua, kam khat in leng adawng kei uh, kumpipa dan thupiak, "Amah dawng ke'n," chih ahi ngal a.
Huchi in kumpipa insung heutu Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joahte'n apuansilh bohkekte uh silh in Hezekiah kiang ah ahoh ua, Rabshakeh thugente ahilh uhi.
